published.name: Perplexity AI
published.overview: Perplexity AI is an AI-powered answer engine that helps users find accurate information from across the internet. Instead of browsing multiple websites, users can ask questions in natural language and receive summarized answers with supporting source links.
published.whyFeatured: Students spend hours searching for information, reading lengthy articles, and collecting research material. Perplexity simplifies this process by providing quick, source-backed answers. It is a useful tool for assignments, technical research, project development, and everyday learning.
published.keyFeatures: Real-time web search with AI-powered answers Source citations for generated responses Follow-up questions for deeper research File and document analysis Focus modes for academic and specialized research
published.bestFor: College students, researchers, developers, content creators, and anyone who wants to research topics efficiently.
published.pricing: Free plan available. Paid Pro subscription offers higher usage limits and additional advanced features.
published.pros: Fast research, source-backed answers, simple interface, useful follow-up questions, saves time.
published.cons: AI-generated answers may occasionally contain inaccuracies. Some advanced features require a paid subscription. Always verify important information using the original sources.
published.howToUse: 1. Visit https://www.perplexity.ai/ 2. Enter a question in the search box. 3. Review the generated answer and its cited sources. 4. Ask follow-up questions to explore the topic further. 5. Use the sources to verify information and continue your research.
published.examplePrompts:
Explain cloud computing in simple terms with real-world examples.
Compare React.js and Angular for building a college project.
Find recent research and explain how artificial intelligence is used in healthcare.
Explain the working of a binary search tree with an example.
published.tags: AI search, Research, Productivity, Students, Free tier
